block.awakening.awakened_totem.tip: The totem murmurs names long forgotten; each one lights another pair of stone eyes.
block.awakening.builder_brick.tip: Each brick carries a Builder's mark. Touch one and you can read half an era.
block.awakening.soul_lantern.tip: A held breath burns inside the wick; stand close and you can hear it sigh.
block.awakening.wither_rift.tip: The air on the other side is warm. Sometimes something else presses against it.
item.awakening.ancient_city_key.tip: Its teeth match the notches cut into the Ancient City Pass.
item.awakening.ancient_city_pass.tip: The ancient guardians recognize this pass. It opens the way — and starts asking questions.
item.awakening.awakened_token.tip: Only the truly awakened can grip it. For anyone else, it burns.
item.awakening.echo_shard.tip: What is left of a broken ender pearl still echoes the sound of its fall.
item.awakening.recorder.tip: The Recorder notes every word you hear. Right-click to advance your era.
item.awakening.resonance_stone.tip: Near sculk voices the Resonance Stone grows warm; it hears what you hear.
item.awakening.soul_compass.tip: The needle always points to the part of yourself you have lost.
item.awakening.soul_shard.tip: A broken voice inside the shard keeps calling out one name.
item.awakening.wither_core.tip: It still beats, slowly, like a heart that refuses to stop.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.awakening: A story-driven Minecraft mod: you are the ancient Builder, reliving 14 eras of history.
